pages.title: MEGAWATT | descender for rope access
pages.shortDescription: The most versatile descender on the market | optimally compact and light
description: The MEGAWATT is a descender for industrial and rescue applications with a working load of up to 230 kg. The transmission mechanism of the lowering lever supports device operation and enables control of the descent speed over a large lever travel. The short lever automatically returns to the park position. The compact design can help reduce the risk of snagging on equipment or structures. The lever shape with rubberised grip inserts supports operation with either the left or right hand. The four-way locking mechanism allows the rope to be installed without disconnecting the device from the carabiner. Steel inserts are integrated in areas subject to increased wear. The anti-panic function supports controlled operation during lowering. It can also be used to reverse the operating direction of the lever, allowing the device to be adapted to different application scenarios. With a weight of 495 g, the MEGAWATT is suitable for a wide range of work-at-height and rescue applications.

pages.name: PINCH
pages.title: PINCH | Belaying with cam-assisted locking
pages.shortDescription: Innovative and versatile belay device with assisted braking
description: Pinch - a new belaying experience with the PINCH, a new, versatile assisted braking belay device for use in sport climbing, multi-pitch climbing and rope access techniques. The PINCH is the first device on the market that can be attached directly to the central ring of the climbing harness. Thanks to its low, close-to-the-body position, the PINCH does not need to be fixed in place when releasing the rope and the brake rope can always be gripped with all fingers. In addition, the compact belay system provides an increased span, which allows the belayer to pay out 20 - 30 cm more rope at once. The linear rope run through the frontal steel braking grooves reduces rope tangles when lowering and abseiling. In addition to the lowering lever, the speed can be controlled by the pressure of the braking hand, which contributes to increased braking rope control, especially when using thin, soft ropes. The anti-panic function provides added safety not only for beginners. A special feature is the integrated second braking tier, which enables controlled lowering by pulling the lowering lever further when securing particularly light persons or in systems with high rope friction. Users and experienced rope access technicians can permanently deactivate the anti-panic function using a screw supplied. Another plus: When used on multi-pitch lengths, the PINCH is the only device on the market that can be attached to the belay station in four different directions in 90° increments. This means that the lowering lever can always be brought into a position in which it can be operated freely.

pages.name: FUSE
pages.title: FUSE | moving fall arrester
pages.shortDescription: Guided type fall arrester for rope access
description: The FUSE is a guided type fall arrester for work-at-height applications. It meets the key requirements of relevant European and North American standards for a user weight of up to 140 kg. The attachment point on the lever arm supports smooth movement of the device along the safety rope during both ascent and descent. A key design feature of the device is the patent-pending separation of the locking mechanism and the speed-dependent activator. The cam operates without teeth, which can help reduce the mechanical load on the rope. In addition, the locking action can be released without completely unloading the system. The locking function allows the clamp to be engaged when required. The device can be attached to and removed from the rope without being disconnected from the carabiner. In combination with the DEFUSER RESCUE energy absorbers (Standard or L), the maximum arrest force is up to 30% below the value required by the relevant standards. Different absorber lengths and performance characteristics allow the system to be adapted to a range of applications, including rescue operations and horizontal use.

pages.shortDescription: Classic paragliding carabiner for recumbent and reversible harnesses
description: The ALIAS is an innovative, lightweight harness carabiner with outstanding strength and a technical design. We usa a special hot forging process to provide maximum breaking strength at minimal weight. Weighting in at just 58 g, this is the lightest carabiner in its class. the specific backbone construction ensures optimal force transmission and loading capacity. In addition, the S-shaped bend prevents cross loading. The safe and secure twistlock gate has been proven in practice. By combining it with the keylock nose, the ALIAS ensures comfortable handling when clipping or unclipping and prevents snagging. The extra-large 12mm opening allows easier operation, while the carabiner`s overall dimensions accommodate a wide range of harnesses from 20 mm to 40 mm. Customised laser engraving on the vertical axis can also be arranged if required.

The release bar prohibits loosen off the webbing during use (like unloaded timeframes walking etc.).

At the same time, the splice offers added safety as part of the core runs through the entire eye. The SPLY is handmade.

pages.name: OHM
pages.title: OHM | Belaying with weight difference
pages.shortDescription: Assisted-braking resistor for rope parties with a major weight difference
description: Get it out, clip it on, start climbing. The popular, tried-and-tested OHM assisted-breaking resistor is not only impressively easy to use but also outstandingly reliable and durable. The OHM is clipped to the first bolt using a carabiner of your choice (certified carabiner according to EN 12275 or EN 362). This can be done in any direction thanks to the swivel joint. The sophisticated closure system furthermore prevents accidental opening. It is also extremely easy to insert the rope and remove the device when lowering. Plus, there is no need to specially set the weight ratio. The OHM makes the climber 25 kg lighter. It breaks even when falling directly into the device, supporting belayers weighing at least 40 kg. This reduces the risk of collisions close to the ground and stops the lighter belayer being pulled upward uncontrollably. Its design and high steel content make the OHM particularly durable. All in all, the OHM offers an important and extremely easy-to-use safety reserve for all rope parties with major weight differences. It is made for innumerable uses when sport climbing at the crag and in the gym, as well as ideal for rental usage.

pages.name: OHMEGA
pages.title: OHMEGA | Rethink belaying
pages.shortDescription: Innovative brake assistant | significantly more safety and comfort
description: Rethink belaying - weighing in at barely 190 g, the compact OHMEGA is a highly versatile brake assistant suitable for use by a wide target group. Whether in climbing gyms, at the crag, or on alpine sport climbing routes (when using a single rope), it offers genuine added value in terms of safety and comfort for both climbers and belayers. This benefits beginners, experienced climbers, and pros as well as rope parties with and without a weight difference. The integrated HMPE sling enables users to switch between three different braking levels with a simple hand movement to suit the weight distribution. The integrated pulley keeps the friction generated at the first bolt lower than when using a quickdraw, so users won’t notice the OHMEGA when climbing or clipping, even on long and difficult routes. Thanks to the short HMPE sling and the resultant minimal activation distance, the belayer finds it easier to belay dynamically and softly, reducing the risk of impact-induced injuries. In the event of a fall, the cam brakes the fall, supporting the belayer and balancing out weight differences. As a result, the belayer won’t be pulled off the ground in the event of a big fall. With falls from a low height, the braking effect of the OHMEGA reduces the risk of both the climbing partners colliding and the climber hitting the ground. The OHMEGA also brakes reliably if the climber falls into the device. Simple, light, and offering enhanced safety and comfort for both climbing partners, the OHMEGA opens up new possibilities and makes belaying a completely new experience.

pages.name: EDELBEAK
pages.title: EDELBEAK | Hardened steel beaks
description: The EDELBEAKs are special, hardened steel beaks for the most extreme placements in thin cracks in all types of rock. They offer reasonable protection and help users progress during technical climbs in demanding alpine terrain. Their sophisticated shape and three sizes make the beaks highly versatile and suitable for placement in icy cracks, frozen turf, or microcracks. They can also grip the smallest ledges as hooks. The cut-outs on the head and shaft reduce the weight while the large, flat back enables the beaks to be hammered in quickly and effortlessly. The Tech Web sling with a Dyneema® core and polyester sheath has a breaking load of 17 kN and enables placement in dihedrals. The second carabiner opening in the head reduces the torsional forces in horizontal placements and makes the beaks easier to stow on the harness or gear loop.

pages.name: LITERIDER LEDGE FLY
pages.title: LITERIDER LEDGE FLY | Portaledge tent
pages.shortDescription: Weatherproof tent for the LITERIDER LEDGE Portaledge
description: The all-weather canopy for the LITERIDER LEDGE! When an approaching storm is moving in quickly or the rain even starts to fall, the LITERIDER LEDGE FLY offers a dry and surprisingly spacious shelter on the wall. It comfortably accommodates four people when seated or two people lying down. An ultra-light pole system forms the FLY’s basic framework, creating a much more spacious interior than a conventional A-frame. This special design makes it possible to sit upright in every corner of the portaledge rather than just along the wall side as usual. Access is possible via both short sides, and two large vents ensure optimum ventilation. The panoramic window on the front grants spectacular views to everyone inside. Thanks to its taped seams and waterproof material with a 20,000 mm water column rating, the FLY is both fully waterproof and able to withstand high winds: A continuous drawcord can be adjusted from the inside to keep the wind out, plus a double diagonal tensioning system significantly minimizes flapping. Both the wall-side longitudinal poles and the corners are reinforced with robust abrasion protection. And if the weather remains unpredictable, the FLY can simply be placed in a compression sack between the LITERIDER LEDGE and the anchor point, so it is quickly to hand if needed.
features: Lightweight and robust tent for the DYNEEMA® LITERIDER LEDGE and the LITERIDER LEDGE PRO
Space marvel: two people lying down, four people sitting
Weatherproof: 20,000 mm water column
Stormproof
Includes practical compression cover

pages.name: LITERIDER LEDGE PRO
pages.title: LITERIDER LEDGE PRO | Portaledge weighing less than 4 kg
description: One of the lightest portaledges on the market! Thanks to an innovative design and the use of exceptionally lightweight materials, we have developed a portaledge weighing less than 4 kg. Whether you need an independent, suspended position or a sleeping spot in alpine or urban environments, the LITERIDER LEDGE PRO is the top choice—and incredibly light! The frame is crafted from 7075 T6 aluminum with oval tubing that delivers maximum flex resistance with minimal wall thickness. This gives the deployed portaledge outstanding stability at minimal weight. All support lines run through the tubes, keeping them secure and protected from loss. The floorsheet is made from lightweight yet highly durable polyester and is tightly stretched over the frame with three buckles. A diagonal center fin enhances both stability and lying comfort, while two integrated hook-and-loop pockets provide storage space for essential items. Additionally, the LITERIDER LEDGE PRO is reinforced on the wall-facing side with a specially abrasion-resistant polyamide strap. The suspension system uses 10 mm HMPE webbing, rated to over 15 kN per strand. These straps are finely adjustable with 10 mm buckles and can be separated to allow multipoint attachment, improving anti-tip stability. For extra protection from wind and weather, the optional LITERIDER LEDGE FLY PRO is the perfect add-on.

pages.name: DRIFT
pages.title: DRIFT | Ice Axe
pages.shortDescription: Ultralight and compact ice axe for ski and glacier tours
description: An ice axe for all those who want to do away with every gram of unnecessary weight in the mountains. The ultralight DRIFT is the ideal companion for ski tours and projects where an ice axe is carried just in case but not constantly used. It weighs a mere 250 g and can even be stowed in a backpack thanks to its compact size of just 45 cm. To avoid damage when doing this, we have rounded all sharp edges. The slightly curved, anodized aluminum shaft is lightweight and has an ergonomic shape and a sandblasted finish to make it easy and pleasant to hold. The ridges in the lower section offer even greater grip. The spike-like tip has an integrated cap to prevent the penetration of snow. The 4 mm steel pick effortlessly penetrates hard snow and ice plus features large cut-outs to make it ultralight like the adze.
features: Aluminum shaft for a very low overall weight
Compact size thanks to the short length
Stable 4 mm pick
Pick and adze made from corrosion-resistant steel
Ergonomically shaped head section: sits optimally in the hand for good control
The middle of the adze is at a right angle to the straight shaft section for greater efficiency when striking
Sandblasted, anodized shaft for better grip plus lower part of the shaft ridged for even more grip (e.g. when striking)
Cut-outs for carabiners in the head and at the end of the shaft
Shaft with a spike-like ‘tip’ in the lower section and an integrated cap to prevent the penetration of snow

pages.name: FIRN GUIDE
pages.title: FIRN GUIDE | Ice Tool
pages.shortDescription: Technical ice axe for demanding and steep high mountain tours
description: The FIRN GUIDE is a technical mountaineering axe for demanding high mountain tours and classic mountaineering. The slightly curved shaft made from robust, light, anodized aluminum has an ergonomic shape and a sandblasted finish. The ridges in the lower section of the shaft offer even greater grip. The pointed, stainless steel pick can be precisely placed and is easy to hold when using the ice axe for support thanks to its ergonomically shaped head. The I-profile of the pick provides good torsional strength at a low weight. The aggressively shaped, sharp adze offers plenty of power and makes it easier to cut steps or dig T-slot anchors. The middle of the adze is at a right angle to the straight shaft section, further increasing the impact when striking. The large cut-out on the pick is designed to effortlessly hold even large carabiners.
